title: Checkout latency spike and payment failures
description: FICTIONAL historical record. Checkout requests timed out for 25 minutes during the morning peak.
symptoms: checkout 503 errors, HikariPool connection is not available, pool active=20 idle=0, slow queries
root_cause: Database connection pool exhausted: long-running reporting queries held connections, so checkout requests waited until the 30s connection timeout.
resolution: Stopped the reporting job, restarted payment-service pods one at a time, then moved reporting queries to the read replica and added a 5s statement timeout.
lessons_learned: Keep batch/reporting work off the transactional connection pool; alert on pool 'waiting' count, not only on latency.

title: Order creation failures during carrier outage
description: FICTIONAL historical record. A third-party carrier API degraded; order-service retried aggressively.
symptoms: 504 on order creation, read timed out calling shipping quote, retries exhausted, worker pool saturated
root_cause: Slow downstream dependency (shipping quotes) combined with 3 retries per request amplified load and exhausted worker threads.
resolution: Reduced retries to 1, lowered timeout to 2s, added a circuit breaker and a cached fallback quote.
lessons_learned: Retries without a budget turn a slow dependency into an outage; use circuit breakers and fallbacks.

title: Inventory pods OOMKilled after catalogue import
description: FICTIONAL historical record. Pods restarted repeatedly after a large catalogue import.
symptoms: OutOfMemoryError Java heap space, OOMKilled exit code 137, Full GC pauses, restart loop
root_cause: Unbounded in-memory product cache grew past the 512Mi container memory limit.
resolution: Capped the cache size, set JVM max heap to 75% of the container limit, raised the limit to 1Gi after profiling.
lessons_learned: Every in-memory cache needs a size bound; memory limits must match JVM heap settings.

title: Notification deployment stuck - missing configuration
description: FICTIONAL historical record. A release renamed a configuration key.
symptoms: CreateContainerConfigError, could not resolve placeholder, readiness probe failed, rollout stuck
root_cause: The new release referenced a ConfigMap/key that had not been created in the cluster.
resolution: Created the missing ConfigMap through the GitOps repository and re-synced; added a pre-deployment manifest check.
lessons_learned: Ship configuration changes together with (or before) the code that needs them; validate references in CI.

title: Payment provider calls failing - TLS certificate expired
description: FICTIONAL historical record (a useful distractor: same service, different cause).
symptoms: x509 certificate has expired, SSL handshake failure when calling the payment provider
root_cause: An expired client TLS certificate for the payment provider integration.
resolution: Rotated the certificate and added expiry monitoring 30 days in advance.
lessons_learned: Monitor certificate expiry; similar symptoms on the same service do not always share a root cause.

title: Search latency due to CPU throttling
symptoms: cpu throttling, slow requests, high load average
root_cause: CPU limit set too low for the new ranking model.
resolution: Raised the CPU limit and added a horizontal pod autoscaler.
lessons_learned: Load-test resource limits when changing compute-heavy code paths.
